notes: Homonym: shares consonants תאב with H8373 ("long for"), already in this dataset -- flagged proactively in H8373's own notes well before this batch, matching Strong's own note that the two are "probably identical... through the idea of puffing disdainfully" (opposite valence: this occurrence, "I abhor the excellency of Jacob", confirms the flagged distinction holds). Per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹), H8373 has been retroactively relabeled תאב¹ in this same batch and this root is תאב².
